knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to select gloves and other PPE from the risk assessment, product label and site requirements, so the PPE must match all three. Colour and habit are not the basis for the choice.
Stop, keep people and clean areas clear, and escalate under the site infection-prevention plan. Do not continue the work when the situation is unclear.
The instruction lists the points where hand hygiene is required, including after glove removal, after handling waste and at task transitions.

practicalCriteria: Follows the authorised sequence and site procedures
Uses suitable tools, product instructions and contamination controls
Recognises and escalates unsafe or out-of-scope conditions
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 8: If an uncontrolled hazard or unauthorised task appears, stop, keep clear and escalate under the site procedure.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 6 is not done: Dispose of or decontaminate used PPE under policy, and never reuse single-use gloves.
Stop work if procedure step 8 is not done: If an uncontrolled hazard or unauthorised task appears, stop, keep clear and escalate under the site procedure.
